name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sustainable aquaculture by reducing financial risk of shrimp farmers through subsidized insurance coverage.Under this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided on insurance premium paid by eligible fish farmers for shrimp crop insurance, helping them mitigate potential crop losses
descriptionMd: The “Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance” is a scheme component under the Intensive Fisheries Development Programme, implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to promote sustainable aquaculture by reducing the financial risk of shrimp farmers through subsidized insurance coverage. Under this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided on the insurance premium paid by eligible fish farmers for shrimp crop insurance, helping them mitigate potential crop losses.
benefitsMd: - 50% subsidy on the insurance premium paid for shrimp crop insurance.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be a farmer and involved in shrimp farming. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID). 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
exclusionsMd: - The applicant must not be a Government/ Semi-Government employee.
